svg.text: Hierarchy induction, one placement decision per step
Toy film-domain vocabulary, routed through the current two-call algorithm (parent check, then child check) with a capacity-triggered consolidation call between types.
PARENT CHECK
does focal belong under a candidate?
CHILD CHECK
does focal subsume a candidate?
CONSOLIDATE
fires between types once a level exceeds B
MERGE
same_concept flag on a parent-check match
1. audiovisual work
2. documentary film
3. film
4. movie
5. war film, action film, biographical film

text.tspan: in-degree is a frequency proxy, not true generality
— a realistic mis-tiering risk the LLM must correct later.

svg.text: band 1 always runs first and sequentially
too shallow — film doesn't exist yet (fixed next)
a later, more general node corrects an earlier too-shallow attachment
“movie” folds in as a surface form — no new node created
film now has 2 children at this level

text.tspan: → none / none → settles as a 3rd sibling

svg.text: no shared parent is invented here —
same_class is not a per-pair action anymore

text.tspan: biographical film descends to film’s level:

svg.text: LLM groups TRUE siblings only (same kind of thing);
documentary film stays out of the group.
a capacity response, not a per-pair judgment —
never fires below B candidates
final tree after all eight steps
Every merge, reparent, and consolidation decision is adjudicated by a dedicated LLM call — never inferred from embedding similarity alone.
